feedback.issue: Incomplete Schema Registry - Only 9 of 47 integration points have defined schemas (19% complete). Missing critical file operations schemas (9/11) and CFN loop communication schemas (6/8). No validation enforcement for unschematized integration points.
feedback.suggestion: BLOCKING: Complete critical schema definitions (2.2, 2.3, 3.2, 3.3, 3.5) before production deployment. Estimated effort: 1-2 sprints. Priority order: File Operations (2.2, 2.3) → CFN Loop (3.2, 3.3, 3.5) → Remaining schemas.
feedback.impact: Validation gaps expose system to unexpected data formats and runtime failures

feedback.issue: Database Migration Rollback Procedures Missing - 9 migrations implemented (001-009) but no documented rollback procedures. Migrations 007-009 from Phase 2 have no tested rollback paths. Cannot safely rollback in production emergency.
feedback.suggestion: BLOCKING: Create documented rollback SQL for migrations 007, 008, 009. Test rollback → forward → rollback cycle. Create incident response runbook. Estimated effort: 3-5 days. Files needed: /db/migration-rollbacks/007-*.sql, /db/migration-rollbacks/008-*.sql, /db/migration-rollbacks/009-*.sql, /docs/MIGRATION_ROLLBACK_PROCEDURES.md
feedback.impact: Cannot recover from migration failures in production. Missing data during rollback.

feedback.issue: File Operations Integration Points Lack Validation - Only 2 of 11 file operation schemas defined (post-edit-backup, agent-output). Missing critical schemas 2.2 (post-edit-validation) and 2.3 (skill-deployment). Hook system has no input validation.
feedback.suggestion: BLOCKING: Define schemas 2.2 (post-edit-validation) and 2.3 (skill-deployment) with comprehensive validation rules. Integrate validation into post-edit-hook.cfn-invoke-post-edit.sh and skill deployment pipeline. Add integration tests for file operation boundaries.
feedback.impact: File operations lack input validation, exposing system to malformed data

feedback.issue: Distributed Lock Enhanced v2 - Task P2-2.2 enhanced distributed lock with mandatory TTL enforcement. Existing code calling old API without TTL parameter will fail with validation error. Breaking change without deprecation warning.
feedback.suggestion: SHOULD DO: Verify all 4 lock instantiation sites provide TTL parameter. Add deprecation warning for old API if maintaining backward compatibility. Document migration guide 'Updating Distributed Lock v1 → v2'. Consider backward compatibility adapter: acquireLockLegacy() function that provides default TTL.
feedback.impact: Existing code patterns may fail if TTL parameter not provided

feedback.issue: Unified Query API Enhancements - Phase 2 enhanced UnifiedQueryAPI with new optional fields in QueryRequest interface. Type changes may introduce breaking changes if new fields become required.
feedback.suggestion: SHOULD DO: Audit all QueryRequest usage to verify all new fields remain optional. Add test case 'QueryRequest backward compatibility'. Document in changelog whether changes are breaking or non-breaking. Consider version the QueryRequest interface if breaking changes detected.
feedback.impact: Potential runtime failures if consumers not updated to new interface

feedback.issue: Schema Validation Middleware Not Integrated - Schema validation middleware created but not wired into Express request pipeline. Routes lack validation endpoint coverage. Missing validation error handling at HTTP layer.
feedback.suggestion: SHOULD DO: Integrate validateRequest() middleware into all relevant Express routes. Add comprehensive validation error handling (HTTP 400 with detailed error messages). Add validation performance metrics to monitoring. Create integration test 'Schema validation at HTTP boundaries'.
feedback.impact: No validation enforcement at API boundaries despite validator being implemented

feedback.issue: CFN Loop Communication Schemas Incomplete - Only 2 of 8 CFN loop communication schemas defined (cli-mode-spawn, broadcast-message). Missing critical schemas 3.2 (task-mode-spawn), 3.3 (agent-completion), 3.5 (confidence-scores). No validation of gate check values.
feedback.suggestion: SHOULD DO: Define schemas 3.2, 3.3, 3.5 for core CFN Loop protocol. Add validation to orchestration layer (CFN Loop coordinator). Create CFN Loop communication test suite. Document confidence score format and gate thresholds.
feedback.impact: CFN Loop protocol lacks validation, increasing risk of orchestration failures

feedback.issue: Legacy Test Suite Syntax Errors - Test file legacy/v1/tests/web-portal/swarm-coordination.test.ts contains TypeScript syntax errors (missing 'catch' or 'finally' keywords). Tests cannot compile.
feedback.suggestion: SHOULD DO: Fix syntax errors in swarm-coordination.test.ts. Run test suite and ensure all tests pass. Consider removing legacy v1 tests if not needed, or updating them to current codebase.
feedback.impact: Test suite fails to compile, blocking CI/CD pipeline

feedback.issue: Schema Versioning Strategy Not Documented - 9 schemas defined with v1.0.0 versioning but no documented strategy for version transitions (v1.0.0 → v1.1.0 → v2.0.0). No migration functions for non-breaking changes.
feedback.suggestion: SHOULD DO: Document schema versioning strategy in /docs/SCHEMA_VERSIONING_GUIDE.md. Define semantic versioning rules (major/minor/patch). Create schema migration function registry for version transitions. Add examples for backward-compatible and breaking changes.
feedback.impact: No guidance for evolving schemas without breaking consumers

feedback.issue: Missing Integration Test Coverage - No integration tests for CFN loop communication (critical for orchestration). Missing health check endpoint tests. No API layer validation tests. Missing data format transformation tests.
feedback.suggestion: SHOULD DO: Create integration test suites for: CFN Loop communication, health check endpoints, API layer validation, data format transformations. Target >80% coverage for all integration points before Phase 3.
feedback.impact: Untested code paths in critical orchestration and API components

feedback.issue: No Documented Recovery Procedures - Missing incident response runbook for production failures. No rollback automation for migrations. No disaster recovery plan.
feedback.suggestion: SHOULD DO: Create /docs/INCIDENT_RESPONSE_RUNBOOK.md with procedures for common failure scenarios. Implement migration rollback automation. Document recovery procedures for database, Redis, and file system failures.
feedback.impact: Team lacks guidance for responding to production incidents

feedback.issue: Schema Validation Performance Not Monitored - IntegrationSchemaValidator targets <50ms validation, <100ms schema loading, but no production monitoring of actual performance.
feedback.suggestion: NICE TO HAVE: Add performance metrics collection to validation middleware. Track p50, p95, p99 validation latencies. Alert if validation exceeds targets. Monitor schema cache hit rate.
feedback.impact: No visibility into validation performance in production

feedback.issue: Integration Point Inventory Not Updated - Planning docs list integration points but integration-points/README.md needs refresh with current status (9/47 vs outdated status).
feedback.suggestion: NICE TO HAVE: Update /schemas/integration-points/README.md with latest completion status. Add section 'Migration Path for Incomplete Schemas' with estimated timelines.
feedback.impact: Documentation out of sync with implementation status

feedback.issue: Error Handling Coverage Gaps - StandardError well-implemented but some service methods may not use it consistently.
feedback.suggestion: NICE TO HAVE: Audit error handling in all services. Ensure consistent use of StandardError with proper error codes. Add test case for error propagation across service boundaries.
feedback.impact: Potential inconsistency in error handling patterns

feedback.issue: Integration Test Isolation - Some integration tests may share state or depend on test execution order.
feedback.suggestion: NICE TO HAVE: Review integration tests for proper isolation (beforeEach/afterEach cleanup). Add test utilities for database/Redis cleanup between tests. Ensure tests can run in any order.
feedback.impact: Flaky tests due to shared state, complicating debugging

feedback.issue: Health Check Integration - Health check system well-designed but not integrated with monitoring dashboard.
feedback.suggestion: NICE TO HAVE: Document health check integration with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog). Create dashboard for system health visualization. Set up alerting for degraded/unhealthy states.
feedback.impact: Health data not visible in monitoring dashboards

feedback.issue: Backward Compatibility Guide Missing - No comprehensive guide for upgrading from v2.14 → v2.15 or planning v3.0 breaking changes.
feedback.suggestion: NICE TO HAVE: Create /docs/BACKWARD_COMPATIBILITY_GUIDE.md documenting all v2.15 changes, breaking changes, and migration procedures. Create /docs/UPGRADE_GUIDE.md for operational teams.
feedback.impact: Operational teams lack guidance for production upgrades

feedback.issue: Adapter Pattern Could Be Extended - Database adapters well-designed but configuration management doesn't use same pattern.
feedback.suggestion: NICE TO HAVE: Consider extending adapter pattern to config sources (JSON, YAML, environment). Would provide flexibility for future config system upgrades.
feedback.impact: Minor architectural inconsistency

feedback.issue: Redis Connection Pooling Not Optimized - Redis adapters use ioredis but connection pool sizing not documented.
feedback.suggestion: NICE TO HAVE: Document Redis connection pool sizing recommendations. Add pool metrics to performance monitoring. Create tuning guide for different load scenarios.
feedback.impact: Potential performance issues with large workloads

feedback.issue: Correlation ID Coverage Incomplete - Correlation IDs implemented but not propagated through all service calls.
feedback.suggestion: NICE TO HAVE: Audit correlation ID propagation through entire request lifecycle. Add middleware to auto-inject correlation IDs. Ensure logging includes correlation IDs everywhere.
feedback.impact: Difficult to trace requests through complex service chains

feedback.issue: Load Testing Coverage Gap - No documented load testing procedures or performance baselines.
feedback.suggestion: NICE TO HAVE: Create load testing suite with scenarios for: concurrent agents, large database operations, schema validation throughput. Document performance baselines for SLA verification.
feedback.impact: Difficult to verify performance under production load

feedback.issue: Credential Handling Not Documented - Database credentials passed via environment but no guidance for rotation, audit, or protection.
feedback.suggestion: NICE TO HAVE: Create security guide for credential management. Document password rotation procedures. Implement credential audit logging. Consider integration with vault systems.
feedback.impact: Potential security gaps in credential lifecycle management

feedback.issue: Circuit Breaker Pattern Not Implemented - Database adapters may fail repeatedly on connectivity issues.
feedback.suggestion: NICE TO HAVE: Implement circuit breaker pattern for database adapters to prevent cascading failures. Add fast-fail mechanism for unhealthy backends. Consider bulkhead pattern for resource isolation.
feedback.impact: Potential cascading failures under adverse conditions

recommended_items: Integrate schema validation middleware into routes

items: Integrate validation middleware into Express routes
Full test coverage for all integration points

confidence_assessment.rationale: Strong architectural foundation with well-designed database abstraction, error handling, and transaction management. However, significant gaps in schema validation (81% of integration points incomplete) and missing database migration rollback procedures are blocking issues. Core components are reliable but critical integration points need completion before production deployment.
